Now build with sanitizers and run a fuzz subset under ASan/UBSan. I'll add an env-var driven fuzz run: modify the fuzzer to accept extra env (it inherits os.environ ✓ since subprocess.run inherits).

ASAN with dlopen of a library that was linked with -fsanitize=address requires LD_PRELOAD of libasan ✓.

Let me set: 
export CFLAGS="-std=c11 -O1 -g -fPIC -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter -fsanitize=address,undefined"
export LD_PRELOAD="/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/9/libasan.so /usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/9/libubsan.so"
export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0
export UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=1

and run a few fuzz rounds.

Note: python subprocess inherits env ✓.

Let me try with the examples first.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && export CFLAGS="-std=c11 -O1 -g -fPIC -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter -fsanitize=address,undefined"
export LD_PRELOAD="/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/9/libasan.so:/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/9/libubsan.so"
export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0
export UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=0
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,subprocess,sys
ex=json.load(open('examples.json'))
for e in ex:
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','project/solver.py'],input=json.dumps(e['input']).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,cwd='/workspace')
    got=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    print(e['name'], 'MATCH' if got==e['output'] else 'DIFF', p.stderr.decode()[:400])
EOF
TMPDIR=/tmp timeout 900 python3 dev/fuzz.py 21 8 2>&1 | tail -12
